title: ExomeFlow: A Production-Quality Python Package for Automated Whole Exome Sequencing Analysis
description:
ExomeFlow is a Python package that provides a complete, automated Whole Exome Sequencing (WES) analysis workflow from raw FASTQ files to functionally annotated variants in a single reproducible CLI command.

It implements the GATK best-practice variant calling pipeline: fastp (QC) → BWA MEM (alignment) → GATK SortSam / MarkDuplicates / BQSR → HaplotypeCaller → SNP/INDEL hard filtering → ANNOVAR functional annotation against 8 databases (refGene, ClinVar, gnomAD, dbNSFP, COSMIC, ExAC, avSNP150, dbscSNV).

Key features:

  • One-command installation: pip install exomeflow
  • Multi-sample cohort processing with checkpointing and resume
  • Automatic dependency detection and setup
  • Docker and Singularity containers for HPC
  • Benchmarked on NA12878 (GIAB): SNP precision 99.4%, F1 78.4%
